ticker_news.title: Netflix, Trump nomination, outages - what's moving markets By Investing.com - Investing.com Canada
ticker_news.description: Netflix reported mixed Q2 results, with better-than-expected subscriber additions but cautious revenue guidance. U.S. stock futures slipped as the earnings season continues. ticker_news.title: Netflix ETFs to Buy on Robust Q2 Earnings - Zacks Investment Research
ticker_news.description: Netflix reported strong Q2 2024 results, beating earnings and revenue estimates. The company added 8.05 million subscribers, driven by the crackdown on password sharing and popular content. Netflix expects revenue growth of 13.9% in Q3 and 14-15% for the full year. Investors could consider ETFs with significant exposure to Netflix, such as FNGS, GGME, FDN, VIRS, and BNGE.
